SwinCells.meaning: Swin cells whose attack cleared the bar and carry PSBD metrics

SwinDatasets.meaning: datasets with at least 1 implanted Swin cell

SwinPlacementsReported.meaning: Swin placements with at least 5 implanted cells

SwinCellsTiny.meaning: implanted Swin cells on Tiny ImageNet

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPublished.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus dropout, after both residual adds, adaptive rule, over 80 cells

SwinGainDropoutInputMinusPublished.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, dropout, attention input minus dropout, after both residual adds, adaptive rule, over 80 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusPreResidual.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus dropout, before both residual adds, adaptive rule, over 80 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusTwin.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus token mask, attention output before the add, adaptive rule, over 80 cells

SwinGainRecommendedMinusSameSiteDropout.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gain, token mask, attention input minus dropout, attention input, adaptive rule, over 80 cells

SwinSelectionHalfRecommendedAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement on the selection half, 44 cells

SwinSelectionHalfTwinAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the twin placement on the selection half, 44 cells

SwinSelectionHalfTwinGap.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gap, recommended minus twin, selection half, 44 cells

SwinReportHalfRecommendedAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement on the report half, 42 cells

SwinReportHalfTwinAuroc.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the twin placement on the report half, 36 cells

SwinReportHalfTwinGap.meaning: Swin paired AUROC gap, recommended minus twin, report half, 36 cells

SwinRecommendedFloor.meaning: lowest single-model AUROC of the recommended placement on Swin

SwinRecommendedBelowChance.meaning: Swin cells where the recommended placement reads below chance

SwinShiftTargetUnreached.meaning: Swin cells whose swept rate ladder never reached the adaptive shift target

SwinHardestAttacks.meaning: the attacks holding the 4 lowest Swin readings of the recommended placement

SwinSeedReplicates.meaning: Swin training-seed replicate checkpoints on disk

SwinRecommendedAurocAdaptive.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule over 86 cells

SwinRecommendedN.meaning: Swin cells carrying the recommended placement

SwinRecommendedTprOneZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of token mask, attention input at the q0.10 budget over 86 cells

SwinRecommendedTprTwoZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of token mask, attention input at the q0.20 budget over 86 cells

SwinPublishedTprOneZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of dropout, after both residual adds at the q0.10 budget over 80 cells

SwinPublishedTprTwoZero.meaning: Swin mean TPR of dropout, after both residual adds at the q0.20 budget over 80 cells

SwinPublishedAurocAdaptive.meaning: Swin mean AUROC of the published placement at the adaptive rule over 80 cells
